title: Second Component of a Pair Encoding
statement: For any binary strings $u,v$ and any $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the bit at position $2|u|+2+j$ of their pair encoding, taking the default value $0$ when that position is beyond the end, equals the bit at position $j$ of $v$, with the same default convention.
